text_excerpt: A slightly more general case of the above is the following. Suppose we have a surjective finite \'etale morphism $X \to Y$ and a finite group $G$ together with a group homomorphism $G^{opp} \to \text{Aut}_Y(X), \sigma \mapsto f_\sigma$ such that the map $$ G \times X \longrightarrow X \times_Y X,\quad (\sigma, x) \longmapsto (x, f_\sigma(x)) $$ is an isomorphism. Then the same result as above holds.
